tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search Korean pensions / pool villas / stays sold by Marginmax. Filter by region (Korean place name in the address, e.g. "가평", "강릉", "제주 애월") and/or keyword (name, facility such as "수영장", "애견", "바베큐"). If checkin/checkout are given, only stays with an available room for the party are returned, cheap

tools.name: get_stay
tools.description: Details of one stay: address, check-in/out time, description, facilities, rooms (capacity, size, amenities, photos, extra guest fees), refund policy (refund % by days before check-in), booking notice, lowest 1-night price in the next 30 days.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Real-time availability and total price (KRW, whole stay) for every room of a stay for the given dates and party. Each available room includes booking_url: the property's official booking page, where the guest enters name and phone and pays to confirm the booking.
